ai-alignment.passionCta: Tell me what you're passionate about?
virtueParagraphs: A mentor I looked up to once asked me what my virtue was, what drives me when nothing else does. I said learning, so quickly it almost didn't sound true.

I sat with that answer for months before realising it really is at my core. When I look at what actually makes me happy, it comes down to a few simple things: learning something new, being part of a community, and helping that community grow.

That, along with my love for technology and psychology, is what led me to cybersecurity, and now to the question that keeps pulling me back: how do we make sure the systems we build actually want what we want, even as they get smarter than us. That question is only going to matter more, and I would rather be one of the people trying to answer it early.
